probe.note: The probe loads the DEFAULT camera, which an earlier attempt reframed onto the hero band, so most of the plan is frustum-culled and this under-reads badly. It is a floor, not a representative load (deferred defect X3). Budget is a ceiling, so the gate passes either way; the optimization pass must re-measure at a representative framing or it will optimize against a fiction.

capture_set.dpr_note: First set captured at DPR 3 rather than 4: the blind reviewer consumes images downscaled to ~2000 px, so DPR 4 paid to rasterize pixels nobody sees — and that downscale has already cost this run attempts (it made present-but-small arrowheads read as ABSENT). At DPR 3 the judge sees near-native pixels.

harness_note: This is the first evidence set in the run captured by the hardened harness: it waits for the canvas element (it never did — a blind 9s sleep hid that for the whole project), settles on a cheap clip through the compositor, flags uniform/blank frames, records the URL that produced each artifact, and EXITS NON-ZERO on a partial set. The previous harness exited 0 with 10 of 24 shots dead.
